prompt:
Research the officially documented limits for Discord users: message length and file upload size, for free users and Nitro subscribers. Cite Discord's own support pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here are the officially documented limits based on Discord’s support pages.

**Message Length**  
- Free users: 2,000 characters per message. Longer messages are converted into a text file.  
- Nitro: 4,000 characters per message.  

**File Upload Size**  
There is conflicting information across Discord’s support pages:  
- An updated FAQ states the free limit is **20MB**, with Nitro Basic at **50MB** and Nitro up to **1GB**. It also notes the increase occurred in August 2026 and applies pre-compression.  
- An older “Account Caps” page lists the free limit as **10MB**, Nitro Basic as **50MB**, and Nitro as **500MB**.  

SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034632292-Sending-Messages | QUOTE: "The character cap per message is 2000." | CLAIM: Free users have a 2,000-character message limit.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034632292-Sending-Messages | QUOTE: "Messages with more than 2000 characters will be converted into a text file." | CLAIM: Exceeding 2,000 characters on a free account converts the message into a text file.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360034632292-Sending-Messages | QUOTE: "You can raise the character cap limit to 4000 when you subscribe to Discord Nitro." | CLAIM: Nitro subscribers have a 4,000-character message limit.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/25444343291031-File-Attachments-FAQ | QUOTE: "As of August 2026, the free upload limit is 20MB (up from 10MB)" | CLAIM: Free users can upload files up to 20MB.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/25444343291031-File-Attachments-FAQ | QUOTE: "If you need more room regularly, Nitro Basic offers 50MB and Nitro offers up to 1GB." | CLAIM: Nitro Basic allows 50MB uploads and Nitro allows up to 1GB uploads.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/25444343291031-File-Attachments-FAQ | QUOTE: "We've now moved mobile to the same pre-compression check that desktop has always used, so the number you see is the number that counts." | CLAIM: File size limits are enforced pre-compression (before compression is applied).  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000435108-What-are-Nitro-Nitro-Basic | QUOTE: "Share larger files up to 1GB - perfect for videos, photos, and more files like videos and photos up to 1GB!" | CLAIM: Full Nitro includes file uploads up to 1GB.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000435108-What-are-Nitro-Nitro-Basic | QUOTE: "Share larger files up to 50 MB!" | CLAIM: Nitro Basic includes file uploads up to 50MB.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000435108-What-are-Nitro-Nitro-Basic | QUOTE: "Express more with up to 4000 characters per message!" | CLAIM: Nitro subscribers can send messages up to 4,000 characters.  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/33694251638295-Discord-Account-Caps-Server-Caps-and-More | QUOTE: "File Sharing Limit | 10MB | 50MB | 500MB" | CLAIM: Free users have a 10MB file limit, Nitro Basic has 50MB, and Nitro has 500MB (note: this conflicts with the newer FAQ citing 20MB/1GB).  
SOURCE: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/33694251638295-Discord-Account-Caps-Server-Caps-and-More | QUOTE: "Message length | 2000 character | Same | 4000 character" | CLAIM: Free users have a 2,000-character message limit while Nitro subscribers have 4,000 characters.
